# Native Omarchy widget verification

`make linux-omarchy-test` now runs the production Rust `OverlayPublisher`, the real native source shell bridge and unchanged production QML through one Rust integration owner. The two Python widget/replay helpers are removed. A separate GActionGroup receives actual review commands; Qt IPC exposes the rendered widget, while private X11 pointer/keyboard events exercise focus and countdown behavior. This proves the component integration, not complete application review scheduling, History, physical inputs or a real Wayland compositor.

The runner prepares Cargo dependencies and the standalone bridge, then isolates HOME/XDG, X11, session/accessibility buses, network/PID/mount namespaces and input/audio/GPU devices. The system-bus socket and default session-service activation directory are masked. It uses software Mesa, explicit compiler caches and offline Cargo. Only installed Omarchy `Commons`/`Ui` components are copied into the private fixture; their desktop configuration reads are redirected there. Owned Quickshell and video-capture process groups are terminated and reaped. No host focus, pointer, clipboard, microphone, credentials, provider traffic or application installation is used.

## Independent release observations

The immutable reference remains v1.6.0 at `5202477edfe4b5d8bacfa5b2e9fd6eadd9624f7f`. A temporary collector outside maintained source executes the untouched released `shell_overlay_smoke.py`, `preview_replay.py` and Python shell command. Before execution it verifies every released Mluva Python module, QML/font/JavaScript asset, helper and fixture against the pinned Git blobs; imported Mluva module paths/hashes are checked again afterwards. No reference handler, publisher, bridge, renderer or expected result is replaced.

The normal released run passes 51 observations in `tmp/native-widget-reference.log`, with raw evidence in `tmp/widget-reference.xYZgmO/`. Its optional replay passes in `tmp/native-widget-reference-replay.log`, with evidence in `tmp/widget-reference.QCDhHn/`. Independent ffprobe observation records H.264, 1280×900 pixels, 60 fps and 300 frames. [The frozen fixture](released-omarchy-widget.json), SHA-256 `d86343237ceceb497782fdd735078358f71a9a1bfad89c46014bf83aa9138c47`, contains these actual outputs and source hashes. It is unchanged by native test results.

The native owner compares all fixed fields of the 51 states and both replay endpoints: phase and text, Unicode preview origins, bar/overlay counts, focus, control visibility/enabling, identifiers/options, theme colors, positions, text geometry, header/timer/drag bounds and appearance settings. Seven clock-derived fields are excluded only from frozen snapshot equality: `dotRadius`, `dotPhase`, `lookAhead`, `textY`, `targetY`, `scrollTarget` and `revisionProgress`. Raw release values remain recorded. Separate live-frame assertions retain scrolling direction/intermediate movement/final alignment, five-line following and contraction, bounded tail wrapping, recording pulse bounds/smoothness, fixed geometry and reduced motion. This is not a byte-identical animation timing or pixel-hash claim.

Actual controls must deliver the expected review tuples exactly once, including a late-message check after settling. Countdown checks retain hover/menu/keyboard pauses, inherited-focus behavior, suspension during rewriting, fresh completion intervals, timeout dismissal and continuation. Owner loss must remove the preview. The replay uses the unchanged three-event [contraction input](../../../../linux/tests/fixtures/preview-contraction.json) and compares selected video-stream metadata, not unrelated ffprobe envelope fields. The replay-only Make option remains available: `MLUVA_PANEL_REPLAY=1 make linux-omarchy-test`.

## Retired helper mapping

The complete helpers, production owners, consumers, sibling checks, Make/CI routing and history were reviewed before deletion. The discovery record is `tmp/native-widget-review.md`.

| Removed owner | Protected behavior | Retained strongest owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `linux/tests/shell_overlay_smoke.py::main` | Recording/review rendering, monitor-bar ownership, presets, five-line geometry, Unicode tails, scrolling/contraction, reduced motion, theme/control settings, streaming/error states, review requests, countdown and owner loss | `omarchy_widget::released_widget_controls_geometry_and_live_motion`, complete release snapshots plus real frame/control/input observations |
| `focus_editor`, `move_pointer`, `press_tab` in that helper | Focus a unique synthetic editor; exercise actual private pointer/Tab behavior without host input | The guarded native owner uses xdotool against the private display and retains focus/countdown observations |
| `linux/tests/preview_replay.py::replay_preview` | Record the existing shrinking-recognition event sequence as a five-second 60-fps video, retaining before/after evidence and cleaning up capture | `omarchy_widget::released_preview_contraction_replay`, released states, actual FFmpeg capture and independent ffprobe stream metadata |

The widget helper's only maintained entry point was the Make target; replay was its optional branch. Relevant history includes `a5c8d36` for recorder ownership, `2d75530` for header/dragging geometry, `a4cf1a6` for motion/video work and `4bcf12a` for continuation controls. Replay history includes `c38e655` and identity migration `19c7579`. The test-only `MLUVA_OVERLAY_SOURCE` alternative-source selector has no other maintained caller; acceptance now always uses the actual production QML. No application feature is removed.

The existing `shell_overlay_fixture.qml` remains at its original path because the showreel capture tool also uses it. The still-used Python overlay implementation and unit tests remain until their application callers are removed. Native `overlay_state` remains the primitive projection/signal owner, and the shell crate's process comparison remains the CLI/owner/activation owner. The new integration check does not duplicate their complete tables or introduce a production test hook. Fixed geometry/text/focus assertions already covered by complete release snapshots were consolidated into that comparison; timing and asynchronous receipt checks remain separate.

## Accepted native evidence

The first native run passes both checks in `tmp/native-widget-first.log`, private evidence `tmp/omarchy-widget/run.9xMsfQ/session.WqiM0F/`. The unchanged previous Make target then fails at the positively checked interpreter trap in `tmp/native-widget-before.log`. Both Python and uv traps have working positive controls.

After switching Make and deleting the helpers, actual `make linux-omarchy-test` passes both checks with absolute Python and PATH uv blocked. Final widget evidence after review is `tmp/native-widget-reviewed.log` and `tmp/omarchy-widget/run.12Sghk/session.Ct2s8Y/`: all 51 states, real private control/input/motion/countdown behavior, both replay endpoints and the 300-frame video match. Earlier confirmation is retained in `tmp/native-widget-make.log` and `tmp/omarchy-widget/run.q9LzCc/session.M0bJPV/`. The saved dark/light widget PNGs were inspected. QML module-name/non-bindable fixture and isolated missing-Hyprland warnings remain in the logs.

The final gate separately passes the replay-only Make selector in `tmp/native-widget-replay-selection.log`. The sibling `overlay_state` suite passes 78 independent projections and ten actual private-bus signals in `tmp/native-widget-overlay.log`. Replay frames before and after contraction were also inspected; the reading area stays fixed and the corrected tail remains visible.

Full `make test` passes **139 tests, zero failures and 67 ignored environment checks across 98 suites**, both strict all-target Clippy configurations, formatting and generated-document consistency in `tmp/native-widget-final-native.log`. `make linux-python-test` passes **571 tests, Ruff and formatting for 161 files** in `tmp/native-widget-final-python.log`; the existing PyGObject deprecation warning remains. The complete driver finishes successfully in `tmp/native-widget-final-gates.log`, private environment `tmp/native-widget-final-gates-evidence/session.Rfz8xt/`. Repository ShellCheck and diff checks pass. No hosted CI job or paid runner was requested.

Review leaves production runtime/QML code unchanged. Make routing adds two/removes thirteen lines; native test/support adds 949/removes 697 lines. The independently observed reference is a separate 190,141-byte/3,830-line data fixture, not a second implementation. This replaces the two Python owners without retaining aliases or introducing production-only test seams. The historical recorder-header link now points to the exact old commit whose helper hash matches that receipt.

No runtime application or QML source changes are needed for this conversion. The protected installed app/widget remain 1.6.0. Full maintained Python removal, joined native application/widget/Wayland and hot-upgrade acceptance, other GUI/platform/model/device workflows and remaining performance measurements stay open. All whole-workflow parity rows remain Pending.
